name: Hisyaryumon
main_effect: [Your Turn] When one of your effects places a digivolution card under this Digimon, you may digivolve this Digimon into a Digimon card in your hand with the [X Antibody] trait by paying its digivolution cost. When digivolving with this effect, reduce the digivolution cost by 1.
source_effect: [Opponent's Turn] While this Digimon has the [X Antibody] trait, it gains ＜Reboot＞ (Unsuspend this Digimon during your opponent's unsuspend phase.).
